Where your swipes, double tap and long press work. Anywhere: also in the space around the buttons and bars, and on the controls below the open lyrics. Anywhere but the lyrics: around the buttons and bars, but not while the lyrics are open. The buttons and bars keep their own taps, and scrolling the lyrics stays just that. With \"Swipe up for the queue\" on, the player\'s lower half is for that swipe.
Swipe a song right to play it next, left to add it to the queue.
